- Apply ice to your heel for 15-20 minutes several times a day to reduce inflammation.
- Consider using over-the-counter pain relievers like ibuprofen to help with pain and swelling.
- Stretch your calf muscles and the bottom of your foot regularly.
- Make sure your running shoes provide good support and cushioning.

If the pain doesn't improve with these measures, or if it worsens, it would be a good idea to see a healthcare provider for a more thorough evaluation. They might suggest physical therapy or other treatments if needed.
